title: Modernize character creation
goal: Redesign the existing character-creation presentation so backgrounds and personality answers feel like meaningful RPG choices rather than a plain web form. Preserve all existing routes, submitted values, validation, and gameplay behavior.
acceptance_criteria: Each character-creation question is visually separated and easy to understand
Background choices are presented as fully clickable cards
Personality answers appear directly beneath the correct question
Selected, hovered, and keyboard-focused choices have clear visual states
Existing form field names, submitted values, routes, and validation remain unchanged
The page remains usable at desktop and mobile widths
Focused presentation tests and the full test suite pass

title: Modernize NPC interaction cards
goal: Improve the presentation of NPCs and their available interactions so NPCs feel like characters rather than database entries. Preserve all existing interaction identifiers, forms, routes, requirements, and rewards.
acceptance_criteria: Each visible NPC has a clear name, role, and readable description hierarchy
NPC interactions are visually grouped with the NPC they belong to
Primary and secondary NPC interactions are visually distinguishable
Unavailable interactions remain understandable and accessible when already supported
Existing interaction IDs, form actions, submitted values, and gameplay behavior remain unchanged
NPC cards remain readable at desktop and mobile widths
Focused presentation tests and the full test suite pass

title: Modernize travel and destination presentation
goal: Improve the existing travel interface so locations feel like destinations rather than raw menu entries. Preserve all location IDs, routes, travel rules, requirements, costs, and gameplay behavior.
acceptance_criteria: Travel options are presented as readable destination cards or destination rows
Each destination clearly displays its name and existing descriptive context
Current location, available destinations, and unavailable destinations are visually distinguishable
Primary travel actions are easy to identify
Existing location IDs, form actions, submitted values, and travel behavior remain unchanged
The travel presentation remains usable at desktop and mobile widths
Focused presentation tests and the full test suite pass

title: Improve action hierarchy and controls
goal: Create a consistent visual hierarchy for existing gameplay actions so important decisions stand out while utility and secondary actions remain quieter. Do not add, remove, rename, or reorder actions in a way that changes gameplay.
acceptance_criteria: Primary actions are visually distinct from secondary and utility actions
Buttons and action controls no longer appear as an undifferentiated wall of identical rectangles
Hover, active, disabled, and keyboard-focus states are clear
Existing action names, routes, form methods, field names, and submitted values remain unchanged
Controls remain accessible and readable at mobile widths
Reduced-motion preferences are respected for any transitions
Focused presentation tests and the full test suite pass

title: Polish typography spacing and visual consistency
goal: Perform a restrained presentation polish pass across the existing player-facing screens. Improve typography, spacing, section hierarchy, borders, and visual consistency without changing content, behavior, architecture, or gameplay.
acceptance_criteria: Location titles, section headings, body text, helper text, and labels have a clear hierarchy
Paragraphs, cards, sections, and controls use consistent spacing
The dark cultivation theme uses restrained parchment, gold, and muted natural accents
Different content types remain visually distinguishable without excessive borders
No existing text, form behavior, routes, or gameplay behavior are removed or changed
Contrast and keyboard-focus visibility remain adequate
Focused presentation tests and the full test suite pass

title: Final responsive and accessibility audit
goal: Audit the completed UI milestone for responsive behavior, keyboard usability, focus visibility, overflow, alignment, and reduced-motion support. Correct presentation defects only; do not redesign mechanics or architecture.
acceptance_criteria: Player-facing pages remain usable at narrow mobile, tablet, and desktop widths
No important text, cards, controls, or panels overlap or create unintended horizontal scrolling
Interactive elements have visible keyboard-focus states
Clickable cards remain usable by keyboard where applicable
Collapsed and expanded sections remain understandable and accessible
Reduced-motion preferences disable or minimize nonessential transitions
Existing routes, field names, submitted values, and gameplay behavior remain unchanged
Focused presentation tests and the full test suite pass
